prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` shows `time 0h 44m` for a flat 3.74 km walk. By Naismith's rule that is 44.9 minutes, and the README says times are rounded to the nearest minute." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files; grep -rn "time\|round\|//\|int(" --include=*.py . | grep -v test | head -50; grep -n -i "round\|minute" README*
sed -n 40,75p src/trailhead/report.py; sed -n 28,45p src/trailhead/plan.py; grep -rn "h \|[0-9]m\b" tests | head -30
head -15 src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/pace.py; cat tests/test_report.py | head -15

cd src/trailhead && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p=open('pace.py').read()
p=p.replace("from math import exp\n","from math import exp, floor\n",1)
p+='''

def format_duration(hours: float) -> str:
    """Hours as ``<h>h <mm>m``, rounded to the nearest minute (halves round up)."""
    whole, minutes = divmod(floor(hours * 60 + 0.5), 60)
    return f"{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"
'''
open('pace.py','w').write(p)
r=open('report.py').read()
r=r.replace("from trailhead.pace import naismith_hours","from trailhead.pace import format_duration, naismith_hours")
r=r.replace("    whole, minutes = divmod(int(summary.hours * 60), 60)\n","")
r=r.replace('f"  time      {whole}h {minutes:02d}m"','f"  time      {format_duration(summary.hours)}"')
open('report.py','w').write(r)
q=open('plan.py').read()
q=q.replace("from trailhead.pace import leg_hours","from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours")
q=q.replace("        whole, minutes = divmod(int(hours * 60), 60)\n","")
q=q.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"','{format_duration(hours)}"')
open('plan.py','w').write(q)
EOF
cd ../.. && git diff --stat && tail -8 src/trailhead/pace.py

cat >> tests/test_pace.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hours", "text"),
    [
        (3.74 / 5, "0h 45m"),  # 44.88 min: rounds up, not truncated to 44
        (0.0, "0h 00m"),
        (0.75, "0h 45m"),
        (5 + 7 / 60, "5h 07m"),
        (12.0, "12h 00m"),
        (59.5 / 60, "1h 00m"),  # rounding carries into the hour
        (2.4 / 60, "0h 02m"),
    ],
)
def test_format_duration_rounds_to_nearest_minute(hours, text):
    assert format_duration(hours) == text
EOF
grep -n "^from\|^import" tests/test_pace.py

sed -i '3s/.*/from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh/' tests/test_pace.py && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15 && python -m trailhead summary --help >/dev/null && echo ok

printf 'lat,lon,ele
0,0,100
0,0.033635,100
' > $TMPDIR/flat.csv && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/flat.csv; git stash -q && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/flat.csv | grep time; git stash pop -q && git status --short
